plugins.name: Safebooru
plugins.description: Safe-for-work images; no account needed. Comes with Vitrine (install it here to bring it back after removing it).

plugins.name: Realbooru
plugins.description: Read through the site's web pages (its API is switched off). No account needed.

changes: An optional account: log in to download your favorites (fav:me).

plugins.name: Rule 34
plugins.description: Needs a free account: API key and user ID (Settings > Sites after installing).

changes: Downloads up to 6 files at once when a search has many (needs Vitrine 1.0.6).
Files are downloaded from the exact address the site links to: the plain address sometimes gave broken copies.

plugins.name: Rule34Hentai
plugins.description: Shimmie2, read through the site's web pages. An account is optional (sign in with your user name and password).

plugins.name: baraag.net
plugins.description: Mastodon server for art: #hashtags (#art #furry, ~#either, -#without) and @profiles. Files and hashtags, the author as the creator. An access token is optional.

plugins.name: Danbooru
plugins.description: Anime-style art. An account is optional (more tags per search, every file, your favorites with fav:me).

changes: Downloads up to 6 files at once when a search has many (needs Vitrine 1.0.6).

plugins.name: Safebooru (Danbooru)
plugins.description: Danbooru's safe-for-work mirror. No account needed.

changes: Downloads up to 6 files at once when a search has many (needs Vitrine 1.0.6).

plugins.name: E-Hentai Galleries
plugins.description: Galleries (doujinshi, manga, image sets) as comics on the Comics page. An account is optional.

changes: Reads the site's pages at one a second again, which the site handles better.
